title: Bintulu Marathon 2026 Review: Sarawak's Coastal-City 42K
seo_title: Bintulu Marathon 2026 Review | Sarawak Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Bintulu Marathon 2026: August 2 in Bintulu, Sarawak. Full marathon on Borneo's central coast — registration now closed.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 in Bintulu, Sarawak — a coastal city on Borneo's central coast — this full marathon offers four distances. Registration is now closed.
verdict: The Bintulu Marathon brings a full 42.195km to Sarawak's central coast — Bintulu, an industrial port city roughly halfway between Kuching and Miri. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). Registration is closed. August in Sarawak is the southwest monsoon — warm and humid but generally drier than the November-February landas season. For runners who secured a spot: a flat coastal course in an under-represented part of Malaysian Borneo.

sections.heading: Bintulu: Sarawak's Central Coast
paragraphs: Bintulu is a port city on Sarawak's central coast — a working industrial town rather than a tourist destination, but one that's developing its sports-tourism infrastructure. [1] Registration is closed for 2026. August conditions are warm and humid.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: Registration closed for 2026. Target 2027 if you want a Sarawak marathon off the Kuching mainstream. [1]
